Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
I enclose the list of the other copies of the [Dove](/book/62) to be sent out besides my own dozen. Our day of departure is still fixed for Monday, but it is very likely to be put off till Friday. I suppose you naturally send copies of my books to the [Guardian](/periodical/75) but it is odd how it has ceased to notice them.
If [Miss Keary](/person/793)’s new book is finished at the same time, I should be glad to have a copy in the parcel.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
